selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config created and applied for ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance disable
selected_evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied with sysctl --system, and confirmed live values (all/default accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route) are 0; also set enp1s0 interface explicitly to 0

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful reconnection with a new boot_id (e47b353b-c3ac-4b50-8850-d2e43af95ce8) proving the node actually restarted

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery verification of the hardening setting
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, all/default accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 confirmed live, interface enp1s0 also shows 0 for both settings, and the /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf file is intact, proving persistence across restart

commands.command:
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf <<'EOF'
# Disable acceptance of ICMP redirects and source-routed packets (IPv4)
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf
